Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 30: the slip of [[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on an exterior Tatooine battleground site. X = the face up destiny number of your Objective. Once per turn, if all your ability on table is provided by aliens, may add X to your ability during battle at a site. This Effect canceled if opponent controls this site.”), word for word the text of [[Tusken Breath Mask (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
